description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-21 when road-to-security-fixes-carried-to-the-merge added the security-fix procedure and the post-update audit step to this skill, which brought it into check_routing_coverage's touched-skill scope. Exemplars cover framework and runtime upgrades, a batch of package bumps, and carrying one advisory to a fix, including a German phrasing. Near-misses: listing which advisories affect the project (the /audit command), releasing a Composer library we maintain (composer-packages), and a container problem (docker). Counterexamples guard 'upgrade' in a billing and a hardware sense.

queries.q: upgrade Laravel from 10 to 11 and tell me what breaks
bump our Node runtime to 22 everywhere it is pinned
update the outdated npm packages and check the changelogs for breaking changes
carry the fastify advisory to a fix PR
aktualisier die Abhängigkeiten und prüf, ob die Tests noch grün sind
which security advisories affect this project right now?
queries.note: listing findings → the /audit command; this skill carries one to a fix

queries.q: tag a new release of our own Composer library
queries.note: publishing a package we maintain → composer-packages

queries.q: the container won't start after I changed the Dockerfile
upgrade my subscription to the team plan
should I upgrade my laptop to more RAM?
